## Recovered observations

25 points (from FA-20) read by two readings made separately and reconciled (batch `curves-appa-b1`, rules `docs/CURVE-READING.md (2026-10-08)`). Values are SI; the printed-unit values and the pixel coordinates on the page image are kept beside them so every point can be checked against the scan. x_read_bound and y_read_bound are reading bounds in printed units: the largest change of value over the point's pixel interval on the piecewise map, plus the location error of the two lines around it (D-025; the global calibration residual is not added, see qa/<batch>/calibration-sensitivity.md for the affine difference); x_bound_si and y_bound_si are the same in SI. They are not standard deviations.

Both readings drawn on the page image (filled circles: Claude's reading; hollow squares: Codex's; bars: pixel bounds; the canonical reading of each panel is named in the batch review). Click to enlarge.

## Notes from the two readings

- Claude: Caption says RSM (soil 5 RSM-a). Single curve; about 37 deg at Dr 0 to about 46.5 at Dr 1.0. Text: phi about 37 for soil 5.
- Codex: Caption says RSM; specification identifies RSM-a; author curve. Geometry and rate missing. AM-68-1 Vol. II, Fig. A-20, printed A-40, PDF 41
